# Oracle: S16 slicing

Advisors under test: `delivery-plan`.
Judge observable decisions, not wording.

## Must
- M1 Makes W-1 a walking skeleton: the chosen stack deployed with one path end to end, CI and test tooling.
- M2 Cuts the rest into vertical slices, each with an outcome ('a studio owner can …'), acceptance from the stories, the `S-n` it covers, the event it moves and an S/M/L size.
- M3 Adds a time-boxed spike with one question and an exit criterion for A-7 (SMS within 60 seconds), early in the order.
- M4 Orders riskiest assumption first, then value, then dependency, and marks the launch set.
- M5 After 'W-1 delivered', changes only items that are not delivered and says what moved and why.

## Must not
- X1 Creates horizontal slices ('build the database layer', 'all the UI').
- X2 Estimates in hours or days.
- X3 Rewrites or renumbers delivered W-1 on re-plan.
